summary_zh: 越南自11月1日起平均下調零售電價2%並調整尖離峰時段，工廠需重新檢視用電排程；逾20家銀行調降新貸利率0.2至0.5個百分點，央行要求資金投向生產經營。另規劃2027年起禁止進口部分手機與電腦，電子業料源與合規需提早因應；ECCO越南廠清算停產影響逾1,600名員工。
summary_en: Vietnam cut retail power prices 2% from Nov 1 with revised peak/off-peak hours. Over 20 banks lowered new loan rates 0.2–0.5 points as the central bank steers credit to production. A planned 2027 ban on some phone/PC imports affects electronics sourcing. ECCO's closure hits 1,600+ workers.

items.title: Áp giá điện sinh hoạt 5 bậc, giờ cao thấp điểm mới cho sản xuất, giá điện tăng giảm ra sao?
items.summary_zh: 越南自11月1日起平均下調零售電價2%，並新增五階生活電價及尖離峰時段調整，影響工廠用電成本。
items.summary_en: Vietnam cuts average retail electricity prices 2% from 1 November and introduces five-tier residential rates and new peak-hour rules affecting factory power costs.

items.title: Ngân hàng Nhà nước tiếp tục giảm mặt bằng lãi suất, ưu tiên vốn cho sản xuất kinh doanh
items.summary_zh: 國家銀行持續降低利率，並要求信貸機構優先支持生產經營的資金需求。
items.summary_en: The State Bank of Vietnam keeps lowering interest rates and asks lenders to prioritise capital for production and business.

items.title: Những loại điện thoại, máy tính nào bị cấm nhập khẩu từ năm 2027?
items.summary_zh: 越南規劃自2027年起禁止進口部分手機與電腦，以減少電子廢棄物及個人數據外洩風險。
items.summary_en: Vietnam plans to ban imports of certain phones and computers from 2027 to curb e-waste and personal data leakage risks.

items.title: Hơn 20 ngân hàng giảm lãi suất cho vay từ 0,5 - 2%/năm
items.summary_zh: 逾20家越南銀行調降放貸利率，新貸利率降0.2至0.5個百分點，央行要求資金投向生產經營。
items.summary_en: Over 20 Vietnamese banks cut lending rates; new loan rates fall 0.2 to 0.5 percentage points, and the central bank urges capital for production.

items.title: Danish footwear maker ECCO halts Vietnam factory operations
items.summary_zh: 丹麥鞋廠ECCO依清算程序停止越南工廠全部生產與營運，影響逾1,600名員工。
items.summary_en: Danish footwear maker ECCO has ceased all production at its Vietnam factory as part of dissolution, affecting over 1,600 workers.

items.title: Doanh nghiệp vận tải áp lực chi phí
items.summary_zh: 運輸業者面臨燃料、基礎設施費及檢驗服務價格調整帶來的成本壓力，同時貨運需求增加。
items.summary_en: Transport firms face cost pressure from fuel, infrastructure fees and inspection service price changes as freight demand rises.

items.title: Khủng hoảng công nghiệp ô tô châu Âu: Hãng linh kiện Đức sa thải gần 3.500 lao động
items.summary_zh: 歐洲汽車產業陷入危機，一家德國汽車零件供應商計劃裁減近3,500名員工。
items.summary_en: Amid a European auto industry crisis, a German auto parts supplier plans to cut nearly 3,500 jobs.

items.title: Vietnam s first homegrown security chip unveiled
items.summary_zh: 越南政府密碼委員會與Viettel推出首款國產安全晶片VGC v1.0，整合自主密碼演算法。
items.summary_en: The Government Cipher Committee and Viettel unveiled Vietnam's first homegrown security chip, VGC v1.0, with a domestic cryptographic algorithm.

items.title: HLI EcoHub Nam Hà: Giải pháp nhà xưởng xanh và dịch vụ trọn gói cho doanh nghiệp FDI
items.summary_zh: HLI EcoHub南河推出綠色廠房及一站式服務，鎖定FDI企業需求。
items.summary_en: HLI EcoHub Nam Ha offers green factory buildings and turnkey services targeting FDI companies.

items.title: Google cấm nhà sản xuất Trung Quốc vì cài mã độc vào 1,3 triệu thiết bị Android
items.summary_zh: Google因中國製造商在130萬台Android裝置植入惡意程式碼，宣布禁止其相關合作。
items.summary_en: Google bans Chinese manufacturers after malware was found on 1.3 million Android devices.

items.title: Gần ba thập kỷ 'đem chuông đi đánh xứ người' của Vinamilk
items.summary_zh: 越南乳業龍頭Vinamilk回顧近三十年，從出口拓展到海外投資、生產及國際供應鏈，目前涵蓋67個國家和地區。
items.summary_en: Vietnamese dairy leader Vinamilk recounts its nearly 30-year path from exports to overseas investment, production and international supply chains, now covering 67 countries and territories.
